dedupe_keys.name: accidents de la circulation de walstat

description: Accidents de la circulation de WalStat is a dataset listed in Spi open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IWEPS WalStat. Sont considérés comme 'accidents', les accidents de la circulation routière impliquant au moins un véhicule qui occasionne des dommages corporels et qui se sont produits sur la voie publique. Notes: (1) Les accidents sont classés selon la conséquence la plus grave. (2) Un accident entre plus de deux véhicules est considéré comme un seul accident. Coverage: Wallonia. The portal files it under Transports, Mobilité. Its keywords are mobilité, circulation, accident, statistiques. The portal shows 289 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-spi-digitalwallonia-portal.
